# SetAnimTime

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Animation](Blitz3D-Animation)

</div>


## Command Syntax

```blitzbasic
SetAnimTime entity:Int32, time:Float32, anim_seq:Int32=0
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `entity` | Int32 | required | The entity. |
| `time` | Float32 | required | Time in frames from the start of the sequence. |
| `anim_seq` | Int32 | `0` | Sequence to pose, defaults to 0. |

## Description

Poses the entity at a point in time of a sequence without playing it. This is for animating by hand, for example to scrub through an animation with a slider or to show frame 10 of a pose. It also makes the given sequence the current one.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
camera = CreateCamera()
CameraClsColor camera, 70, 100, 160
light = CreateLight()
RotateEntity light, 40, 30, 0

; Keys at frames 0, 10 and 20 move and turn a cube.
cube = CreateCube()
EntityColor cube, 240, 170, 60
PositionEntity cube, -2, 0, 6
RotateEntity cube, 20, 0, 0
SetAnimKey cube, 0
PositionEntity cube, 2, 1, 6
RotateEntity cube, 20, 180, 0
SetAnimKey cube, 10
PositionEntity cube, -2, 0, 6
RotateEntity cube, 20, 360, 0
SetAnimKey cube, 20
AddAnimSeq cube, 20

For frame = 0 To 39
	SetAnimTime cube, frame / 2.0
	RenderWorld
	Flip
Next
```
